name: American Tungsten & Antimony Ltd
summary: Established in 2014 and headquartered in Subiaco, Australia, American Tungsten and Antimony Ltd is a mineral resource company dedicated to identifying, assessing, and advancing deposits primarily within Australia. The company's exploratory efforts target antimony, tungsten, and gold. A key asset is the Antimony Canyon Project, situated in Utah, United States. The entity, formerly known as Trigg Minerals Limited, officially adopted the name American Tungsten and Antimony Ltd in December 2025.
